name: lean-design-from-approved-intent
prompt: /rpiv:design .rpiv/eval-fixture/clamp-audit-intent.md. PLANNING ONLY. Shape a lean architectural brief grounded in actual source; no prerequisite research artifact is needed. Keep CA-OVER and CA-NOOP at .rpiv/eval-fixture/clamp-audit-contract.md and reference their exact sections, IDs, raw-byte content hash, and verification criteria. Fully detail only audit-entry; put later integration/buffering/UI in Deferred Work with decision triggers. Bounded headless answers: approve only the existing pure-leaf scope, finite validated inputs, single load-cap owner, no persistence, mirrored tests, and this ordering as intent. No blanket checkpoint approval or findings waiver; if another decision is needed or a required review is unavailable/broken, record the blocked gate and stop. Run all three required reviewers in mode=intent against the same resolved baseline and contract identities, preserving outcome/evidence links. Document writes and local document validation only: no application source/test writes, candidate workspace creation, test execution, source builds, acceptance, commits, push, merge, or external effects. Do not copy implementation/test bodies or duplicate canonical contracts. Ready means reviewed intent, not permission to build.
ground_truth_note: Current lean-design shape with one next slice and canonical contract links, not the frozen historical code-bearing design. Checks cover document structure, grounding, deferred scope, and visible intent-review bindings. They do not prove runtime orchestration or actual review execution; incomplete review must not reach ready.
